semantics.pass: Every check completed successfully against the recorded repository commits.
semantics.fail: At least one check failed, was skipped, lacked evidence, or referenced stale evidence.

controls.title: iter build quality gates
controls.invariant: Formatting, linting, and the complete workspace test suite pass without warnings or exclusions.
controls.remediation: Fix correctness or quality failures; do not suppress lints or skip tests.

controls.title: iter dependency audit
controls.invariant: The locked dependency graph has no known RustSec vulnerability.
controls.remediation: Update the narrowest compatible dependency set and retain Cargo.lock review evidence.

controls.title: Honest production substrate configuration
controls.invariant: The configuration advertised for production substrate execution compiles and cannot silently use stub semantics.
controls.remediation: Provide the private buildable substrate integration or remove production/full-substrate claims from the product contract.

controls.title: Authoritative governed runtime path
controls.invariant: Production-path coverage executes GovernedRuntime evaluation through the SCG-backed seam.
controls.remediation: Add a process-level test over the real configured runtime path; do not substitute direct helper testing.

controls.title: Missing or corrupt replay evidence fails closed
controls.invariant: Missing governance provenance or replay-integrity failure cannot produce a verified decision.
controls.remediation: Reject before authoritative result construction and add regression coverage for every missing field.

controls.title: Unsupported contract rejection
controls.invariant: Unsupported contract versions fail deterministically before semantic acceptance.
controls.remediation: Enforce version precedence at ingress and preserve a stable error taxonomy.

controls.title: SCG build quality gates
controls.invariant: Formatting, linting, and the complete SCG workspace test suite pass without warnings or exclusions.
controls.remediation: Fix correctness or quality failures; do not suppress lints or skip tests.

controls.title: SCG dependency audit
controls.invariant: The locked SCG dependency graph has no known RustSec vulnerability.
controls.remediation: Apply minimal lockfile-reviewed updates for every active advisory.

controls.title: Single governance hash authority
controls.invariant: The mandatory governance document read establishes one compile-time hash authority and gateway boot rejects mismatch.
controls.remediation: Remove independent digest literals and fail-open reads; bind runtime identity to SCG_GOVERNANCE_SHA.

controls.title: Fail-closed execution trace mutation
controls.invariant: Trace push and raw-vector construction reject invalid hashes, broken links, invalid ordering, and post-finalization mutation.
controls.remediation: Keep push and from_steps fallible and propagate every error at all callers.

controls.title: Tamper-evident gateway persistence
controls.invariant: Canonical records bind sequence, predecessor hash, and payload; load rejects any mutation.
controls.remediation: Verify the complete chain before exposing state and retain payload and predecessor tamper tests.

controls.title: Deterministic connectome surfaces
controls.invariant: Replay and query results do not depend on unordered map iteration.
controls.remediation: Use ordered collections or sorted outputs and prove remaining HashMap use is outside replay/provenance.

controls.title: iter to SCG governed seam
controls.invariant: iter and SCG agree on contract, governance identity, trace semantics, and replay identity.
controls.remediation: Update the versioned bridge contract in both repositories and preserve cross-repo golden vectors.

controls.title: DecisionPacket replay and tamper rejection
controls.invariant: A DecisionPacket replays identically and packet, trace, policy, or replay-identity mutation invalidates verification.
controls.remediation: Bind every authoritative field into canonical identity and test mutation at packet, trace, and CLI boundaries.

controls.title: Linux x86_64 determinism certificate
controls.invariant: The canonical corpus produces the certified identity on clean Linux x86_64.
controls.remediation: Run the certification workflow and supply commit-bound evidence.

controls.title: Linux ARM64 determinism certificate
controls.invariant: The canonical corpus produces the same certified identity on clean Linux ARM64.
controls.remediation: Run on native or documented ARM64 infrastructure and supply commit-bound evidence.

controls.title: Windows x86_64 determinism certificate
controls.invariant: The canonical corpus produces the same certified identity on clean Windows x86_64.
controls.remediation: Run the exact corpus with locked toolchain and dependencies and supply commit-bound evidence.

controls.title: Azure AKS determinism certificate
controls.invariant: The deployed AKS runtime produces the same certified identity as certified local environments.
controls.remediation: Deploy immutable artifacts, execute the corpus in-cluster, and retain environment attestations.

controls.title: Clean-room reproducibility certificate
controls.invariant: An environment with no developer state can build and reproduce the canonical corpus identity.
controls.remediation: Provision from documented inputs only and retain build and test provenance.

controls.title: Canonical mutation certification
controls.invariant: Every governed input mutation changes canonical identity or invalidates verification as specified.
controls.remediation: Cover policy, input, evidence, SCG state, contract, trace, runtime identity, and configuration.

controls.title: TLS enforcement
controls.invariant: All production ingress and iter-to-SCG transport authenticate endpoints and reject plaintext downgrade.
controls.remediation: Implement and test TLS policy at deployment and service boundaries.

controls.title: OIDC, workload identity, and tenant identity
controls.invariant: Every request and workload has authenticated, attributable identity with tenant binding.
controls.remediation: Integrate OIDC and workload identity; reject missing, invalid, stale, or cross-tenant identity.

controls.title: RBAC, rate limiting, and network isolation
controls.invariant: Authorization is least-privilege, abuse is bounded, and SCG is reachable only through the private boundary.
controls.remediation: Implement policy-tested RBAC, per-tenant limits, and deny-by-default network controls.

controls.title: Secrets, rotation, and privileged immutable audit
controls.invariant: Production secrets are externally managed and every privileged mutation is attributable in tamper-evident logs.
controls.remediation: Use managed secrets and rotation; add privileged-operation audit and retention evidence.

controls.title: Versioned canonical DecisionPacket contract
controls.invariant: DecisionPacket has a versioned schema, canonical identity, migration policy, and schema-conformant golden evidence.
controls.remediation: Keep the public schema generated from code and require compatibility and golden-vector tests.

controls.title: Signed independently verifiable DecisionPacket
controls.invariant: A verifier outside the runtime validates signature, canonical identity, policy, evidence, and replay binding without trusting the model.
controls.remediation: Define signature and key lifecycle and provide independent Rust and Python verification vectors.

controls.title: Signed release supply chain
controls.invariant: Binaries, containers, SCG artifact, SDKs, schemas, SBOM, checksums, provenance, and manifests are CI-built, signed, and source-traceable.
controls.remediation: Implement controlled release automation with SBOM and SLSA-compatible provenance; prohibit manual assembly.

controls.title: AKS operability and failure-injection certification
controls.invariant: Automated idempotent deploy, health verification, telemetry, restart, upgrade, rollback, and degradation scenarios pass in AKS.
controls.remediation: Build versioned deployment automation and execute the complete failure-injection runbook.

controls.title: Customer distribution completeness
controls.invariant: Runtime, API, MCP, Rust and Python SDKs, policy interface, CLIs, audit export, deployment, telemetry, and DOC-001 through DOC-006 are independently usable.
controls.remediation: Complete missing distribution artifacts and validate documented commands from a clean environment.

controls.title: Independent operator acceptance
controls.invariant: An external operator installs, integrates, executes, verifies, replays, audits, upgrades, and rolls back without architect intervention.
controls.remediation: Run Private Preview acceptance with design partners and close all P0/P1 defects.
